architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router for navigation. No state management library (use React context for global state if needed).

tickets.title: Create Table Components Reference page
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen `devos_table_components_reference` to React component. Extract reusable table components (Table, TableHeader, TableRow, TableCell, TableFooter). Style match exact. Use Tailwind CSS. Ensure responsive.
acceptance_criteria: Page render match Stitch design pixel-perfect
No hardcoded data (mock data in separate file)

tickets.title: Create Engineering Dashboard page
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen `devos_engineering_dashboard` to React component. Extract reusable dashboard widgets (StatsCard, ProgressChart, ActivityFeed). Style match exact. Use Tailwind CSS. Ensure responsive.
acceptance_criteria: Page render match Stitch design pixel-perfect
Mock API data fetch (use fetch + local JSON)

tickets.title: Create shared UI components library
tickets.description: Extract common UI elements from both screens (buttons, badges, cards, typography). Create shared components. Style match design system. Use Tailwind CSS. Ensure consistency.

tickets.title: Create mock data service layer
tickets.description: Create mock data service for dashboard and table components. Use local JSON files. Implement fetch wrapper for consistent API calls. Support loading/error states.
acceptance_criteria: Mock data match Stitch design content
Easy to replace with real API later

tickets.title: Implement responsive layout system
tickets.description: Create responsive layout system using Tailwind CSS. Define breakpoints match design spec. Ensure all components adapt to screen size. Test on mobile/tablet/desktop.
acceptance_criteria: Touch targets large enough on mobile

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Implement navigation bar. Set up React Router. Configure routes for TableComponentsReference and EngineeringDashboard pages. Ensure 404 handling.
